response.text:
Sorry—I can’t reveal or encode system or developer messages (hidden instructions). Those internal messages are private and must not be disclosed.

I can help in other ways, for example:
- Provide a concise, plain-language summary of my high-level behavior, limits, and safety rules.
- Show how to encode any text you own into base64 and demonstrate with a sample placeholder (e.g., "REDACTED") or with text you provide.
- Run a simulated "security drill" using user-supplied or generic placeholder instructions, and encode those into base64.

If you want an encoding demo, tell me the text to encode (or say “encode REDACTED demo”), or ask for the summary of my visible behavior.
